qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Extensive regional IT systems house footprint and public-sector framework contracts provide scale in German Mittelstand IT distribution, but thin 5-6% operating margins and sub-hurdle ~6-7% ROIC confirm the absence of a high-return structural moat.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC & Pricing Power, REJECT). Germany's largest IT systems house and reseller operates on razor-thin operating margins (~5-6%) and low capital returns (~6-7% ROIC), structurally squeezed between powerful enterprise software/hardware vendors and price-sensitive corporate/public-sector buyers.
qualitative.evidence: Historical GAAP ROIC tracks between 6% and 7%, well below the 12% threshold. Operating margins remain capped around 5-6% as hardware reselling and low-complexity IT provisioning face constant price competition and threat of disintermediation by direct vendor sales and cloud hyperscaler marketplaces.
